objective: Validate the implemented local-only Project Intelligence watch mode against a real local file-change cycle in an isolated fixture or worktree, proving foreground startup, debounce refresh, status artifact update, artifact freshness, and graceful manual/abort stop behavior without hosted services or target repo writes.
acceptance: Run watch mode in an isolated local fixture or worktree and trigger at least one accepted docs/code/autopilot file change.
Verify debounce coalesces the change into a deterministic refresh cycle.
Verify project-intelligence snapshot, agent context, and watch status artifacts are refreshed in the expected order.
Verify ignored generated/dependency/cache/secret paths do not trigger refresh.
Verify graceful stop via abort/manual boundary without daemonizing or leaving a background process.
Record smoke evidence in operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and .autopilot progress.

summary.runtime_hardening: Recursive fs.watch was replaced with bounded polling after smoke exposed EMFILE pressure.
